data.gender_notes: Asali is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word asl, which means 'gentle, delicate, or tender'. In Islamic tradition, the name Asali is believed to represent the qualities of kindness, compassion, and grace. The name Asali carries the meaning “Gentle, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Asali usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
